text: we have yet another loop cut problem. so evaluate this shape. [Image #19] and then im going to loop cut it and notice how the cut does this [Image #20] it slants and you cant unslant it
resolution: Diagnosed the slanted loop cut on the tapered obelisk: the edge-mode loop cut (framework/gpu/3d.zig meshTopoLoopCut) built its cut plane perpendicular to the raw selected-edge direction, so a leaning side edge produced a tilted plane and a slanted ring that no gizmo move could level. Fixed by snapping the plane normal to the edge's dominant world axis (through the edge midpoint) — a mostly-vertical leaning edge now cuts a flat horizontal ring, axis-aligned edges behave exactly as before, matching the axis-aligned face-popup loop cut family. Needs a Zig rebuild to take effect.
